# Private Arcs — Schema Reference Only

Arcs in this folder are for the content generator to learn from STRUCTURALLY — NOT to be used as source content for public posts.

## Absolute rules

1. Never quote specific field values from these arcs in any Twitter, LinkedIn, or Discord post
2. Never reference character names, rival names, mentor names, signature move names, or opening quotes from these arcs
3. Never reference scenario details, life situations, or personal framings from these arcs
4. Do NOT include arcs from this folder as a "source arc" in any output file header

## What you CAN use these for

- Understanding the real arc output schema (field names, nesting, field types)
- Calibrating to the depth and voice of high-quality real arcs
- Recognizing what fields exist (core_stats, character_arc, numeric_stats, signature_move, etc.) so posts can reference the *concept* of those fields generically

## Example — what's allowed vs not

✅ ALLOWED: "every arc comes with a signature move and an episode one mission" — generic structural reference

❌ NOT ALLOWED: "got 'The Preemptive Exit' as my signature move and i'm not okay" — quoting a specific value from a private arc

When the generator needs a source arc for arc-specific content, it pulls from `.github/content-context/arcs/` (the public folder), not this one.
